description: This file defines utility functions for Vulkan-based tensor operations within the ATen library of PyTorch, including tensor layout conversions, buffer copying, broadcasting utilities, and texel extraction.

methods.name: nchw_to_nc4hw
methods.description: Converts a tensor from NCHW to NC4HW format.

methods.name: create_staging_tensor
methods.description: Creates a staging tensor from a vTensor object.

methods.name: nc4hw_to_nchw
methods.description: Converts a tensor from NC4HW format back to NCHW.

methods.name: copy_buffer_to_buffer
methods.description: Copies data between Vulkan buffers with synchronization.

methods.name: copy_buffer_to_vtensor
methods.description: Copies data from a Vulkan buffer to a vTensor.

methods.name: copy_vtensor_to_buffer
methods.description: Copies data from a vTensor to a Vulkan buffer with synchronization.

methods.name: pack_buffer_to_vtensor
methods.description: Packs buffer data into a vTensor.

methods.name: pack_staging_to_vtensor
methods.description: Copies data from staging buffer to vTensor.

methods.name: pack_vtensor_to_staging
methods.description: Copies data from vTensor to staging buffer with optional fencing.

methods.name: is_broadcastable
methods.description: Checks if two tensors are broadcastable.

methods.name: broadcast_size
methods.description: Calculates broadcasted size for two tensors.

methods.name: extract_texel
methods.description: Extracts a texel value from a tensor at a specific position, useful for debugging.

methods.name: api::utils::ivec2 make_ivec2(const IntArrayRef ints,bool reverse=false)
methods.description: Creates a 2D integer vector with optional reversal.

methods.name: api::utils::ivec4 make_ivec4(const IntArrayRef ints,bool reverse=false)
methods.description: Creates a 4D integer vector with optional reversal.

methods.name: int64_t normalize(const int64_t dimension,const int64_t n)

ctags.name: normalize
ctags.pattern: /^inline int64_t normalize(const int64_t dimension, const int64_t n) {$/
